title: Where Agent Defenses Fail: A Case Study of Policy Compositions and Measurement Limits
abstract: arXiv:2611.31541v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A coding agent may need to upload a report while its sandbox blocks network access. A host mediator can restore delivery, but an injected instruction may add a secret to the approved request. We study this interaction using files and HTTP receipts to measure effects independently of control logs. Two prospective frozen-input cohorts comprise 110 and 300 runs on previously explored authored tasks. Restrictive sandboxing produces no observed attack harm but reduces benign utility to 6/8 and 12/24. Mediation restores uploads and admits disclosure; complete-line matching retains full benign utility but misses two value-only disclosures in the expanded cohort. A separate 72-run boundary study identifies encoded disclosure, observer misses, and formatting checks that obscure benign refusals. An 80-run SafeAgents/OpenShell follow-up shows that containment stops the tested guard misses among valid observations, while mediation restores benign

translated_title: 智能体防御失效之处：策略组合与测量局限的案例研究
translated_abstract: 编码智能体可能需要上传报告，而其沙箱会阻止网络访问。宿主中介可以恢复传输功能，但注入的指令可能会在已批准的请求中添加机密信息。我们使用文件和HTTP回执来研究这种交互，以独立于控制日志的方式测量效果。两个前瞻性冻结输入队列分别在先前探索过的自创任务上进行了110次和300次运行。限制性沙箱未观察到攻击危害，但将良性效用降低到6/8和12/24。中介机制恢复了上传功能却允许了信息泄露；完整行匹配保留了全部良性效用，但在扩展队列中遗漏了两次仅泄露值的攻击。一项单独的72次运行边界研究识别出编码泄露、观察者遗漏以及掩盖良性拒绝的格式检查问题。一项80次运行的SafeAgents/OpenShell后续研究表明，遏制机制在有效观察范围内阻止了测试中发现的防护遗漏，而中介机制恢复了良性效用。
tldr: 本文通过大规模案例研究揭示了智能体安全防御策略组合的固有矛盾：限制性沙箱虽能阻止攻击但严重损害良性效用，中介机制虽恢复功能却可能放行机密泄露，且现有测量方法存在编码泄露、观察者遗漏等盲区，为智能体安全评估的局限性提供了实证依据。
en_tdlr: This large-scale case study exposes the inherent trade-offs in agent defense policy compositions: restrictive sandboxing blocks attacks but degrades benign utility, mediation restores functionality yet can admit secret disclosures, and current measurement approaches suffer from blind spots including encoded disclosures and observer misses, providing empirical evidence of the limits of agent security evaluation.
